meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Haan — **Indian skin par white cast avoid karna hai**, toh main mineral-only sunscreen ke bajay **chemical/hybrid, lightweight formula** choose karunga. Recent Indian-skin tests/reviews mein ye options consistently achhe dikhte hain. [www.femina.in](https://www.femina.in/beauty/skin/amp-stories/7-best-sunscreens-that-do-not-leave-a-white-cast-on-indian-skin-286871.amp?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 Sunscreen]()
*₹810*

### [Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹580.50*

### [Fixderma Shadow SPF 50+ Gel]()
*₹339*

### [The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹431*

### Meri top picks

**🥇 Overall: Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++**  
- White-cast-free finish
- Fragrance-free, non-comedogenic
- Lightweight and everyday use ke liye easy
- Brand bhi specifically white-cast-free claim karta hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/skin-body-1/products/multi-vitamin-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**Agar bina zyada soch ke ek lena hai, ye meri pick hai.**

**🥈 Oily skin: Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch SPF 50**  
- Matte/dry-touch finish
- Sweat/oil control ke liye better
- White cast generally noticeable nahi hota. [drnishitaranka.com](https://drnishitaranka.com/blogs/best-sunscreen-for-indian-skin-a-dermatologists-complete-guide-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Budget + lightweight: Fixderma Shadow SPF 50+ Gel**  
- Gel texture
- Deeper Indian skin tones par bhi minimal/no visible cast ke liye popular. [www.femina.in](https://www.femina.in/beauty/skin/amp-stories/7-best-sunscreens-that-do-not-leave-a-white-cast-on-indian-skin-286871.amp?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**💧 Dry/normal skin: The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++**  
- More hydrating feel
- White cast ke bina lightweight option.

**Mera simple verdict:**  
👉 **Normal/combination skin → Minimalist**  
👉 **Oily skin → Re'equil**  
👉 **Dry skin → Derma Co Aqua Gel**

Agar tum mujhe **apni skin type (oily/dry/combination) + budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata do, main **sirf 2 best options** choose karke bata dunga.
